messages:
Alex: Quick heads-up — ran an adaptive ceiling-smoothing sweep for max_tokens_per_batch across A10/T4/L4 after last night's perf regression. TL;DR: smoothing reduces p99 spikes when KV fillrate jumps, but it hurts steady-state throughput on T4.
Jess: Good, can you drop the numbers and config you used? :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Alex: Summary (staging canary, mixed seq lengths):
- A10: p50 ~0% delta, p95 -5%, p99 -18% (spike windows) — tokens/sec -2%
- T4: p50 +1%, p95 -8%, p99 -12% but tokens/sec -9% (throughput regression)
- L4: similar to A10, p99 -15%, tokens/sec -3%
Cost: small increase for T4 due to lower aggregate throughput, A10/L4 cost neutral.
Pranav: Do you have kernel-selection traces? my suspicion: smoothing reduces instantaneous batch collapse, but also produces more small batches that hit a suboptimal kernel path (kernel fallback/quantization-unfriendly) on T4.
Alex: Yep — grabbed profiler slices. Kernel-miss-rate (optimized->fallback) correlated tightly with small-batch fraction. Snippet of the experiment config we used:
```
experiment:
  smoothing_window: 120s
  max_tokens_ceiling:
    A10: 12000
    T4: 8000
    L4: 10000
  dynamic_scale: true
  min_batch_tokens: 256
```
Profiling excerpt: kernel_miss_rate: T4 18% (baseline 3%), A10 4% (baseline 2%). KV_frag_rate spikes aligned with high submission variance.
Lina: How are you measuring KV fill rate? We should correlate prefix-length distribution + cached_kv_hit_ratio. If cached_kv_hit_ratio drops below 70% the fragmentation increases. Suggest threshold tuning before adjusting ceilings.
Alex: Agreed. Observed pattern: transient burst of long-context requests pushes KV fillrate down -> runtime aggressively shrinks ceiling -> causes many tiny batches while cache is still warming -> kernel selector chooses non-optimized kernels -> p99 spikes. Smoothing defers ceiling contraction so we ride out the transient, but on T4 the sustained small-batch footprint still reduces throughput.
InfraBot: deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for experiment/ceiling-smooth-1735551111 to staging (5% of capacity).
Jess: Proposal to mitigate T4 throughput hit: raise min_batch_tokens to 512 for T4 so kernel selector has enough tokens to pick the optimized kernel. Also consider increasing kernel selection hysteresis.
Pranav: We can also force kernel pinning for T4 for batches >= 256 as an experiment — that'll show whether fallback is the main culprit. If pinned kernel holds, then smoothing + pinning might give p99 wins without throughput loss.
Lina: Metrics to watch for next run: p99 latency, tokens/sec, kernel_miss_rate, kv_frag_rate, cached_kv_hit_ratio, and cost-per-token. Add per-model sequence-length buckets.
Alex: Plan: run a 3x sweep on staging tomorrow 09:00 PT: smoothing_window in [60s, 120s, 240s] x min_batch_tokens [256, 512, 1024] x kernel_pinning [off, T4_pin_>=256]. Will run each config for 30m steady-state and 10m burst window.
Jess: Sounds good. Can you paste the command you used to start the canary?
Alex: Command used:
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/api/experiments -H "Authorization: Bearer $CI_TOKEN" -d '{"name":"ceiling-smooth-1735551111","targets":["staging"],"config":{...}}'
```
SRE Oncall: If this touches prod routing or autoscaler behavior, please notify #incidents early. Keep canary traffic <= 5% and monitor the p99 alert we put in place.
Pranav: I'll open EXP-3742 with these parameters and attach the profile traces. Will include a short runbook: rollback by disabling smoothing flag + restoring previous ceilings.
Lina: One more thought — we should check compile-time kernel heuristics: some kernels have sharp performance cliffs under <512 tokens on T4; if that's true we may just need to update kernel selector cost model rather than per-GPU ceilings.
Alex: Good call. I'll add kernel selector loss surface profiling to the sweep. Starting tomorrow 09:00 PT.
Jess: ack :thumbsup:
SRE Oncall: noted. Will watch alerts during the window.
Pranav: assigning myself to the experiment ticket, will post results and traces here when done.
Alex: Thanks all. Quick wins: try T4 min_batch_tokens=512 + hysteresis=30s and rerun short canary tonight if infra capacity allows.
Jess: i'll carve out the T4 slot for a 20m sanity check tonight.
Alex: great — will post raw traces + flamegraphs after the run. :eyes:
